items.source: destinationName - the name of the target destination
request - the payload for the request message to send
items.translation: request - 要发送的请求消息的有效负载

items.source: targetClass - the target class to convert the payload of the reply to
items.translation: targetClass - 将回复的负载转换为目标类的类

items.source: the converted payload of the reply message, possibly null if the message could not be received, for example due to a timeout
items.translation: 回复消息的转换后的负载，如果无法接收该消息（例如由于超时），则可能为 `null`。
requestPostProcessor - 请求消息的后处理程序

items.source: Extends MessageRequestReplyOperations and adds operations for sending and receiving messages to and from a destination specified as a (resolvable) String name.
items.translation: 扩展MessageRequestReplyOperations，并添加向作为（可解析）String 名称指定的目的地发送和接收消息的操作。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name, convert the payload request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message and send it to the resolved destination, receive a reply and convert its body to the specified target class.
items.translation: 解析给定的目标名称，将负载请求对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其封装为消息并发送到解析后的目标，接收回复并将其主体转换为指定的目标类。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name, convert the payload request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message, apply the given post-process, and send the resulting message to the resolved destination, then receive a reply and convert its body to the specified target class.
items.translation: 解析给定的目标名称，将负载请求对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其封装为消息，应用给定的后置处理，然后将生成的消息发送到解析后的目标，接着接收回复并将其主体转换为指定的目标类。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name, convert the payload request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message with the given headers and send it to the resolved destination, receive a reply and convert its body to the specified target class.
items.translation: 解析给定的目标名称，将负载请求对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其包装为带有给定标头的消息并发送到解析后的目标，接收回复并将其主体转换为指定的目标类。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name, convert the payload request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message with the given headers, apply the given post-process, and send the resulting message to the resolved destination, then receive a reply and convert its body to the specified target class.
items.translation: 解析给定的目标名称，将负载请求对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其包装为带有给定标头的消息，应用给定的后置处理，并将生成的消息发送到解析后的目标，然后接收回复并将其主体转换为指定的目标类。

items.source:
Resolve the given destination name to a destination and send the given message,
receive a reply and return it.
items.translation: 将给定的目标名称解析为目标并发送给定的消息，接收回复并将其返回。

items.source: headers - the headers for the request message to send
items.translation: headers - 要发送的请求消息的标头

items.source: the received message, possibly null if the message could not be received, for example due to a timeout
items.translation: 接收到的消息，如果无法接收消息（例如由于超时），则可能为 `null`。
